contract: one counterexample per required AC (test-plan §8 / §10); each patch deviates MINIMALLY from the v0.12.1 contract at the seam the bound test reads, nothing else. The bound test is the test-plan §8 registered node for that AC.

verification.session: 2026-10-27 M-TEST WRITE (v0.12-hotfix-262). Each patch was applied to the delivered tree, the bound node was executed, the behavioural failure was observed, and the working tree was restored byte-exactly (apply -> run -> apply -R). Nine of nine patches killed their bound node.
verification.apply_check: every patch passes `git apply --check` at this head; the killed node failed on a behavioural assertion (never on a collection / import / fixture error).
verification.seams_not_yet_delivered: the three new interface stubs (tracks/executor/full_f_authority.py, review_findings.py, host_env.py) raise their contract token, so the nodes bound to them are already Red at the seam; their counterexamples are the DEVON implementation task's own mutation set (the interface-stub body) and are therefore recorded as authored-awaiting-producer rather than a product-file patch.
verification.stub_token_nodes: the nodes that bind a stub seam (the FULL_F authority matrix, the blocking-findings arbiter, the host-env allowlist) carry their discriminating assertion in the SAME test function: the stub token is converted into a plain assertion failure so the Red classifies as behavioural, and the test's remaining assertions (the independent grounds) still separate a wrong implementation from a right one.
verification.red_gate_revision: 2026-10-27 M-TEST WRITE revision 2 (the RED_GATE classified round 1 as check=test_defect, reason=unexpected_pass, with two nodes passing): the two passing nodes asserted the PRE-EXISTING behaviour instead of the hotfix's new contract, so they were hollow anchors. test_legacy_single_prism_key_preview_readable now compares the legacy single-'prism'-key blob against the CURRENT split-key preview (the asymmetry INV-5 requires: the legacy blob stays readable, while a newly assembled preview must still fail against a current preview missing the full_f key); test_malformed_or_blocking_security_blocks_release now carries BOTH a verify_final and a security verdict so the 'no verify_final -> failed' fallback cannot mask the blocking findings, and it pairs the blocking chain with an identical control chain without findings that must stay green. After the rewrite all 29 selected nodes fail, and the nine counterexample patches still kill their bound nodes.
